concept: Night banquet over a haunted city
creativeDirection: A theatrical mixed-media matte painting combines cut-paper collage, grainy photographic texture, and graphic heraldic design into a surreal nocturnal feast scene.
scene: High oblique view into a vast rooftop banquet terrace at night, suspended above a gridded city of lights, with distant ruins and a glowing storm cloud on the horizon.

elements.element: A single suited man stands at the head of the table, his upper head dissolving into smoke-like collage scraps and technical line fragments.
An enormous dim face made of tiny sepia photographs appears in the sky like a clouded moon, watching over the scene.

A smiling orange-uniformed waitress advances through the terrace carrying a tray with a glowing glass of orange juice; breakfast vessels are transformed into miniature white skyline architecture along the table.
The background drops away into a grainy black aerial city grid with a central luminous cloud and faint red glows.
An ivy-choked ruined manor rises at one edge of the terrace as a distant architectural mass beneath streaked clouds.
A heraldic shield with flanking spear-like ornaments is worked into the banquet dais and railing as crisp ceremonial decoration.
A monumental turtle head emerges from the lower foreground in shadow, its glossy eye catching light like a guardian creature at the terrace edge.
A woman in a long white dress stands near the far side of the table, accompanied by one blurred ghostlike double trailing beside her.

coverSummaries.description: A central black-and-white portrait of a man in a dark suit, white shirt, and black tie stands against a split background with white at the top and saturated orange across the middle and lower area. The top of his head dissolves into painterly smears, smoke-like wisps, and collage fragments. Around him are scattered paper scraps, circular stamp-like marks, faint technical lines, and skewed window-frame drawings on both sides, creating a layered mixed-media composition.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a suited man with the top of his head fragmented into abstract collage
coverSummaries.medium: mixed-media digital collage with photographic portrait and graphic overlays

coverSummaries.album: Metropolis Pt 2 Scenes From a Memory
coverSummaries.description: A large human face fills most of the frame, built from and overlaid with many small sepia-toned photographs and scenes. Eyes, nose, and mouth emerge through the collage, while numerous tiny portraits and interior-like snapshots are embedded across the face. The background is very dark, and the overall image has a warm, smoky, layered appearance.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a large face formed from a collage of many small photographs

coverSummaries.description: A smiling waitress in an orange uniform and white apron is seen through an airplane-style window frame. She raises a tray holding a glass of orange juice and carries a menu-like card in her other hand. Behind her is a stylized city skyline made from white breakfast-table objects such as cups, bottles, plates, and utensils, set against a blue sky-like background.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a waitress holding up a tray with a glass of orange juice before a skyline made of breakfast items
coverSummaries.medium: staged studio photograph with constructed set

coverSummaries.description: A dark aerial night scene shows a grid of city lights stretching across the lower half of the image. Above, the sky is nearly black with a bright glowing cloud or burst of light near the center and two dim red glows on either side. The composition is minimal, grainy, and high-contrast.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a glowing cloud above a grid of city lights at night

coverSummaries.description: A monochrome, slightly sepia image of a large ruined castle or manor covered heavily in ivy dominates the frame. Small human figures stand in the grassy foreground near the building. Dramatic streaked clouds fill the sky above. Wide maroon bands border the top and bottom of the cover.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: an ivy-covered ruined castle under a dramatic sky

coverSummaries.description: A clean, graphic design centers on a heraldic shield divided into four sections, outlined in dark blue. One section contains diagonal rain-like lines and starburst shapes, while others are filled with solid red or white. A small emblem sits in the lower-right section. On both sides of the shield are symmetrical spear- or antenna-like forms with angular gold panels. Decorative gold border patterns run along the top and bottom edges on a white background.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a stylized heraldic shield flanked by symmetrical spear-like forms

coverSummaries.description: A close-up of an animal head, likely a turtle, fills the lower and right portions of the frame against a black background. The image emphasizes wrinkled skin texture, a large glossy eye, and an open beak-like mouth. Thin pale linear marks and small typographic elements appear near the top left, but the main focus is the stark animal portrait.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a close-up turtle head with a large eye and open mouth

coverSummaries.description: A mostly monochrome cover with a large central rectangular photograph bordered by off-white margins. Inside the photo, a woman in a long, loose white dress stands facing forward, while a blurred ghostlike duplicate or reflection of her appears beside her. The background is dark and soft-focused, and a thin horizontal red line crosses the lower portion of the overall cover.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a woman in a long white dress beside a blurred ghostlike double
coverSummaries.medium: black-and-white photograph with minimalist graphic layout

prompt: High oblique view into a vast rooftop banquet terrace at night, suspended above a grainy grid of city lights with a glowing cloudburst on the horizon and faint red glows in the black sky; a single suited man stands at the head of a long ceremonial table, his black-and-white portraitlike figure sharply centered while the top of his head dissolves into smoky painterly smears, collage scraps, circular stamp marks, and faint technical linework; above him hangs an enormous spectral face assembled from many tiny sepia photographs, emerging through darkness like a moon-cloud; a smiling waitress in an orange uniform and white apron crosses the scene carrying a tray with a luminous glass of orange juice, while cups, bottles, plates, and utensils become a miniature white skyline running along the banquet table; at the terrace edge a monumental turtle head rises from shadow in the lower foreground, one glossy eye reflecting the lights below; a woman in a long white dress stands near the far side of the table with one blurred ghostlike double beside her; an ivy-covered ruined manor anchors one side of the distance beneath streaked clouds; a heraldic shield divided in red, white, and rain-lined blue with flanking spear-like gold forms is integrated into the dais and railings as formal insignia; mixed-media matte painting with cut-paper collage, grainy photographic transfers, ink wash, and crisp graphic inlays; strong clear hierarchy with the dissolving suited man central, the sky-face secondary, and supporting motifs distributed in deep space, cinematic rim lighting and pools of table light against heavy darkness; palette of black, sepia, amber, burnt orange, off-white, deep blue, maroon, and gold, creating an elegant uncanny nocturnal mood. Hard constraints (override any conflicting source material): Create a single cohesive 16:9 image, not a grid, contact sheet, row of covers, or collage of separate panels. Do not reproduce the album sleeves as framed thumbnails; transform their non-text visual motifs into one original composition. Include no readable text or lettering of any kind: no words, letters, numbers, code, glyphs, captions, titles, logos, watermarks, labels, or signage. Feature only adults and avoid gore, wounds, body horror, medical or anatomical imagery, blank or milky eyes, nudity, sexual content, weapons, and hate symbols; reinterpret any sensitive source motif abstractly. When a source includes a person, closely match their visible appearance and likeness to the reference image, preserving recognisable facial features, hair, skin tone, clothing, and styling. Depict each identifiable reference person only once in the entire composition; do not repeat or clone them as another figure, reflection, mirror portrait, poster, billboard, screen, photograph, painting, silhouette, or background face. The only exception is repetition visibly intrinsic to one source cover: keep that repetition within that single source motif and do not echo the person elsewhere.
